behavior: Resolver, REST lookup and audit classification are covered by tests in internal/spec, and at least one test runs
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/spec/... -run 'Archive.*Issue|IssueState' -count=1 -v 2>&1); rc=$?; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^=== RUN'); [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$n" -ge 1 ]

behavior: A closed or unanswerable tracking issue makes dotf spec audit exit non-zero
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/cmd/... -run 'TestSpecAuditExitIssueState' -count=1 -v 2>&1); rc=$?; n=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^=== RUN'); [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
